question: What claim is made about the transmission of the practice of the soul to the one addressed as Bhairavī?
premises: This practice of the soul is indicated.
It is said to have been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
The statement is made emphatically with conjunction.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The agent of telling is not named in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
